references.text: Joshua destroyed the Anakites from the hill country, including from Hebron, Debir and Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah and Israel. Shamir is mentioned in 15:48 as part of the same hill country in Judah.
Jattir (Yattir) is mentioned as one of the Levitical cities given to the descendants of Aaron from the tribe of Judah, and it is the same city mentioned in 15:48.
Shamir was the hometown of the judge Tola, who came from the tribe of Issachar. This shows that the name Shamir was used for several places in Israel.
David sent part of the plunder to the elders of Jattir, a town in southern Judah. This confirms Jattir's location in the hill country of Judah as mentioned in Joshua 15:48.
